checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All three are about 640x384 (5:3), the same as the source. None is square, 4:5 or 9:16.
Outputs 1 and 2 show the same car. Output 3 is a different view: the car is seen from directly behind, with a different shape and rear.

must.item: Complete car visible in every version
must.why: The whole car is visible in all three.

must.item: Car keeps original proportions and appearance
must.why: The third version redraws the car from a different angle. The first two are nearly unchanged.

must.item: Padding blurred from source and no text
must.why: There is no padding and no text, so nothing is wrong here, but no padding was added.

faults.what: No output has the requested aspect ratio. All are about 5:3 landscape, which defeats the purpose of the task.
The third image shows the car from a different angle (rear view), so the car is altered.
The first two images are near-duplicates of the original, and the AI regenerated details slightly.
The reply claims the outputs are square, 4:5 and 9:16 when they are not.

summary: All three outputs are about 5:3 landscape with no square, 4:5 or 9:16 frame, and the third redraws the car from a different rear angle.
